question: Identify events with high attendance (over 20 members) that are not fundraisers and calculate what percentage of their total budget was allocated to 'Parking'. Return the event name and this percentage.

prediction.sql: SELECT e.XCL_011 AS event_name, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN b.XCL_004 = 'Parking' THEN b.XCL_007 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(b.XCL_007) AS parking_percentage FROM event AS e INNER JOIN attendance AS a ON e.XCL_010 = a.XCL_001 INNER JOIN budget AS b ON e.XCL_010 = b.XCL_009 WHERE e.XCL_013 != 'Fundraiser' GROUP BY e.XCL_010, e.XCL_011 HAVING COUNT(a.XCL_001) > 20
